policy_document: Camden Statement of Licensing Policy 2025 to 2030 (Licensing Act 2003)
research_notes: LAPSED. Under the 2022 interim Statement of Licensing Policy (published 31 Jan 2022) this was one of Camden's two cumulative impact policy areas, a pre-2018-style CIP 'adopted in 2022' per the 2023 CIA report, never supported by a s5A CIA. The 2024-11-19 Licensing Committee report para 5.4 says the CIAs 'provide a rebuttable presumption to refuse any new licence applications, or any variations to premises licences in these areas'. The Six-Till-Six/MAKE Associates CIA research report (Oct 2023) concluded 'on balance, there is insufficient compelling evidence to justify the publication of a CIA ... in any part of the borough of Camden'. On 19 Nov 2024 the Licensing Committee 'resolved ... that there was not sufficient evidence of cumulative impact in the Camden Town and Seven Dials areas to require a Cumulative Impact Assessment Statement. As a consequence, these cumulative impact policy areas have been removed from the draft Policy' (2025-04-30 report para 2.10). The SLP 2025-2030 (adoption scheduled at Full Council 21 July 2025; expires 23 July 2030) contains no CIA. The area therefore lapsed when the 2025 policy took effect (about July 2025). No GIS boundary was found on opendata.camden.gov.uk (catalogue searched for 'cumulative', 'impact area', 'seven dials'). However, the Camden Licensing Register dataset (rv9z-rsui, updated 15 Oct 2026) has a field 'Cumulative Impact Policy Area Name' that still tags 296 in-force records (266 premises licences) as 'Camden Town'. These points (sources/camden/opendata/licensing_register_rv9z-rsui_tagged_CIP_areas.geojson) can be used to sanity-check a digitised boundary. Their convex hull runs Chalk Farm / Hawley Road / Camden Street / Plender Street / Crowndale Road / Mornington Crescent / railway. The field appears to be a legacy attribute, not evidence that the CIP is in force. Stakeholders in the CIA wanted the Camden Town CIP to stay; the Licensing Committee nonetheless removed it.
